caption: The drawing depicts three bonnets, each elaborately decorated and viewed from the side. The bonnet on the top left is illustrated in a light gray color, with a wide band of lace edging and a large striped bow rendered in shades of pink and cream, with matching pink ribbons hanging down. The bonnet on the top right features similar lace edging, but the bow and ribbons on this bonnet are shaded in blue with touches of pink, and the blue ribbons are longer and hang straight downward. The bonnet at the bottom is depicted in grayscale, with intricate linework detailing the woven texture, a wide ribbon and bow, and additional smaller ribbons, all in shades of gray and black. Each bonnet is contained within a lightly drawn rectangular border, and the background is a plain, uncolored off-white.
title: Caps
